days.title: Villages and Moors of the North and West
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Schlehdorf
stops.detail: At Schlehdorf, north below Herzogstand and Heimgarten, the Loisach flows into the western part of Lake Kochel.

stops.name: Loisach-Kochelsee-Moore
stops.detail: While the southern area of the lake is surrounded by mountains, the northern part is already located in the flat Alpine upland and is bordered by the Loisach-Kochelsee Moors.

stops.name: Birg
stops.detail: The history of the settlement of Kochel began on the so-called Birg near Altjoch, a rocky cone directly on the shore of Lake Kochel.

stops.name: Herzogstand
stops.detail: There are also opportunities for downhill skiing at the Herzogstand, from which one overlooks Lake Kochel and Lake Walchen.

stops.name: Wasserkraftwerk Walchensee
stops.detail: At the same time, on average the same amount of water flows in from Lake Walchen – and thus from the Isar – through the Walchensee hydroelectric power station.
